description: Header file defining the BlobCache class for storing compiled program blobs in memory and optionally on disk, with associated hash utilities and cache management functions.

classes.name: egl::BlobCache
classes.description: A cache for storing program blobs, supporting in-memory and disk storage, with cache management functionalities.

classes.name: egl::BlobCache::Value
classes.description: Represents a cached value with a pointer to data and size, non-owning.

methods.name: BlobCache
methods.description: Constructor initializing cache with maximum size.

methods.name: put
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the cache, optionally invoking application callbacks.

methods.name: putApplication
methods.description: Stores a key-value pair in the application cache if callbacks are set.

methods.name: populate
methods.description: Repopulates cache with a key-value pair from disk without triggering callbacks.

methods.name: get
methods.description: Retrieves a blob from the cache using a scratch buffer.

methods.name: remove
methods.description: Removes a blob associated with a key from the cache.

methods.name: resize
methods.description: Resizes the cache, discarding current contents.

methods.name: entryCount
methods.description: Returns number of entries in cache.

methods.name: trim
methods.description: Reduces cache size to a limit, returning bytes freed.

methods.name: size
methods.description: Returns current cache size in bytes.

methods.name: areBlobCacheFuncsSet
methods.description: Checks if cache callback functions are set.

methods.name: isCachingEnabled
methods.description: Checks if caching is enabled based on callback functions or max size.
